purpose: Stable product pack-out record for a later Chinese factory report. Do not invent millimetres or product claims.
units: Always millimetres in saved files, even if the UI showed cm.

contents.pcs_per_pack: bags per roll (trash) or pieces per box (ziploc). Not used for cling if film size is set.
contents.label_en: 37 bags / roll | 30 pieces / box | 29 cm × 20 m film
contents.label_zh: 每卷37只垃圾袋 | 每盒30只 | 保鲜膜 29 cm × 20 m

film.thickness_mic_one_side: From factory, e.g. 20 or 25. Not carton wall.
film.bag_length_mm: Open bag length including the +50 hem, e.g. 540+50=590
film.ignore_from_factory: Factory carton size, 40 rolls/carton, pallet, container. We use our own carton inner and rolls_per_carton.

roll_convention: L = axis length, W = H = diameter.
box_convention: L = length, W = depth/thickness, H = height. Dieline flaps are not part of LWH.
grid_LWH: Counts along carton inner L, W, H after the winning axis-aligned orientation.

roll_scale.formula: D^2 = D_core^2 + 8 n W L t / (pi * axis)
roll_scale.V_film: n * 2 * W * L * t (two walls, t in mm)
roll_scale.core: Calibrated from the base SKU (n_base, D_base). Not invented.
roll_scale.carton: Keep window grid and leftover slack. Carton L = nx*axis+slack, W = ny*D+slack, H = nz*D+slack.
